blocks.text: Buying Farms & ALR Acreages in Tsawwassen & South Delta, BC

parts.t: Agricultural land around
Tsawwassen
stretches across the sunny coastal lowlands north of 28 Avenue, along 52 Street, 56 Street (Highway 17), and 64 Street toward
Ladner Rural
, Brunswick Point, and
East Delta

. Protected within British Columbia's Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and zoned A1 Agricultural by the City of Delta, these fertile deltaic parcels benefit from the highest annual sunshine hours in Metro Vancouver and established municipal drainage and irrigation systems.

blocks.text: ALC House Size & Secondary Dwelling Rules

parts.t: Under Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) rules and Delta A1 zoning, the principal residence on an ALR parcel is capped at 500 m² (5,382 sq ft) of total floor area, with one additional 90 m² (969 sq ft) residence permitted subject to municipal permits.
South Delta farmland supports commercial potato, vegetable, berry, forage, greenhouse, and horse-boarding operations, qualifying active farms for BC Assessment Class 9 Farm Status.

Lowland farm parcels sit inside the diked Boundary Bay and Fraser River floodplain and require engineered fill pads meeting City of Delta Flood Construction Levels (FCL) for new residential buildings.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Farms & ALR Acreages — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Where is ALR farmland located near Tsawwassen?
Farmland surrounds the Tsawwassen urban peninsula along the 56 Street, 52 Street, 64 Street, and Highway 17 corridors, connecting into Brunswick Point,
Ladner Rural
, and
East Delta
What is the maximum farmhouse size permitted on Tsawwassen ALR land?

BC Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) regulations and City of Delta A1 zoning limit the principal farmhouse on an ALR parcel to 500 m² (5,382 sq ft) of total floor area unless a non-adhering residential use application is approved by both Delta Council and the ALC.
Can you build a second dwelling on a Tsawwassen ALR farm?

ALC regulations permit one small secondary residence up to 90 m² (969 sq ft) of total floor area on qualifying ALR parcels, subject to City of Delta building permits, septic engineering, and Flood Construction Level compliance.
How does a Tsawwassen acreage maintain BC Assessment Farm Class (Class 9)?

To maintain Class 9 Farm Status and low agricultural property tax rates, the parcel must meet BC Assessment's annual gross farm income thresholds through active crop, livestock, or greenhouse production by the owner or under a written farm lease.
What water, drainage, and septic systems serve Tsawwassen farms?

Most roads bordering Tsawwassen ALR parcels have municipal domestic water mains at the property line and municipal agricultural drainage/irrigation ditches, while domestic wastewater relies on private engineered septic systems.
Does GST apply to purchasing a farm in Tsawwassen?

GST treatment depends on whether the property is sold as an ongoing commercial farm operation, leased agricultural land, or a rural residential acreage. Always have a CPA review the contract allocation between the farmhouse + 0.5 hectares and the remaining farmland.
How do Tsawwassen farms compare with Ladner and Cloverdale farms?
Tsawwassen and
Ladner farms
share South Delta's mild coastal microclimate and rich alluvial soils, whereas
Cloverdale farms
offer smaller 2- to 10-acre hobby and equestrian parcels further east in Surrey.
